messages:
gina: opened PR #5120 to tidy the hello-sparrow quickstart: replace the long PKCE walkthrough with a short ephemeral-token quickstart, add a tiny Docker deploy snippet, and correct sample links. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120

omar: nice. For clarity: main quickstart shows ephemeral tokens for frictionless first-run; include a short "When to use PKCE" appendix?

gina: exactly  appendix added with a 3-bullet migration checklist and link to full PKCE sample.

tara: CI linkcheck failing: docs reference /samples/sparrow-old which was removed in samples repo.

ci-bot: build failed  jobs/docs/linkcheck  1 broken link: /samples/sparrow-old -> 404

gina: fixed to /samples/sparrow-kit and added a note about pinning the sample commit SHA so tutorials don't drift. Pushed.

vik: quick nit: Docker snippet uses REDWOOD_API_KEY but our JS snippets use REDWOOD_KEY. prefer one name to avoid confusion.

omar: +1 to REDWOOD_KEY. shorter and matches most examples.

gina: switched all snippets to REDWOOD_KEY and added an env var compatibility table mapping legacy names.

tara: added a tiny local-dev CORS troubleshooting block with a curl check for Access-Control-Allow-Origin to save incoming support tickets.

ci-bot: linkcheck OK; docs/lint reported minor warnings: docs/quickstart-hello-sparrow.md:line 50 sentence length.

omar: editorial: swap "production-ready" phrasing for "recommended for demo and staging" so we don't imply full production endorsement.

gina: updated wording and requested reviews from @omar and @tara.

omar: approved. :thumbsup:

tara: approved. merging after main CI is green and backporting the appendix to release-2.x.

gina: merging now :shipit: will follow up with a tiny docs-only PR to update the samples README with env var recommendations and a compatibility table. Thanks all!
